_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.src: Return to the Dogun Village with the letter and speak to Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.dst: Вернись в деревню Dogun с письмом и поговори с Korzim.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.src: We...have an issue. A dire one... Where is...Axelus at a time...like this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.dst: У нас… беда. Страшная… Где же… Axelus в такое… время?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.src: Oh... From Axelus, then...? He could not find...a stone? That...does not bode well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.dst: О… Значит, от Axelus…? Он не нашёл… камня? Это… не к добру.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#004.src: He is trying to...reason with the Dwarven King? There is...no one else...then. You... You will have to...help.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#004.dst: Он пытается… образумить короля дворфов? Тогда… больше некому. Ты… Тебе придётся… помочь.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#004.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.src: The chieftain is...desperate. He has enacted a...terrible plan. They are planning on summoning Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.dst: Вождь… в отчаянии. Он задумал… страшный план. Они хотят призвать Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.src: If they succeed...we all die. Dwarves... Doguns... Possibly even Villagers...and then... Humans as well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.dst: Если выйдет… мы все умрём. Дворфы… Dogun… Может, даже селяне… а потом… и люди.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.src: Garaheth is a...horrible demon. We used to worship him...thousands of years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.dst: Garaheth… ужасный демон. Мы поклонялись ему… тысячи лет назад.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.src: I only overheard parts... But enough to be certain. They are preparing...to the south. At a disused...ritual site.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.dst: Я слышал лишь обрывки… Но достаточно. Они готовятся… на юге. На заброшенном… месте ритуалов.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.src: Meet me there... Do not just attack. We may be able to...resolve it peacefully. I will wait...by the staircase.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.dst: Встретимся там… Не нападай сразу. Может, удастся… решить миром. Я буду ждать… у лестницы.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.src: Investigate the structure to the south.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.src: We shall take the east tower... Hide there...and watch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.dst: Займём восточную башню… Спрячемся там… и будем смотреть.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.src: Interrupting...at this point will have...disastrous consequences. We must let them continue...and pray they fail.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.dst: Вмешаться… сейчас значит… навлечь беду. Пусть продолжают… а мы молимся, чтобы у них не вышло.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.src: Reach into the darkness...and grasp the hand of Garaheth to purge the intruders...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.dst: Протяни руку во тьму… и сожми длань Garaheth, дабы истребить чужаков…
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.src: This is a worst-case scenario... Meet me in {p}. We will talk more there...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.dst: Худший из исходов… Встретимся в {p}. Там поговорим…
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.src: Travel to {p} and meet Korzim at the entrance. [{~},-{~}]
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.dst: Отправляйся в {p} и встреть Korzim у входа. [{~},-{~}]

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.src: Hoho...! Over here...fine traveler! Join me at the gates!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.dst: Хо-хо…! Сюда… славный путник! Ко мне, к воротам!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.src: This dwarf voice is...horrible on my throat...but it is an effective disguise...is it not?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.dst: Этот голос дворфа… ужасно дерёт горло… но маскировка хорошая… не так ли?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.src: We are headed to...a blacksmith in town. Follow me...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.dst: Мы идём… к кузнецу в городе. За мной…
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.src: Talk to the blacksmith in {p} at {~} {~} -{~}

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.src: ...Korzim...what in the name of all that is holy is that disguise?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.dst: …Korzim… во имя всего святого, что это за маскировка?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.src: I'm flabbergasted you fooled anyone with that thing! How did you stop the beard from burning?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.dst: Поражаюсь, что ты кого-то этим одурачил! Как борода не сгорела?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.src: But, erm...more importantly, who's the buck in the fancy armour there?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.dst: Но, э… что важнее, кто этот франт в нарядных доспехах?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.src: An ally...of the coalition. No time...Edula. Doguns... summoning... Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.dst: Союзник… Коалиции. Некогда… Edula. Dogun… призывают… Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.src: So...so it's really down to that low, then. Burning your own house down to kill the rats.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.dst: Так… значит, дошло до такого. Спалить свой дом, чтобы извести крыс.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.src: Good thing we've got this prepared. One fallout will prevent the next. Soldier, I've got a list of materials we need!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.dst: Хорошо, что мы подготовились. Одна беда предотвратит другую. Солдат, вот список нужных материалов!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.src: You will need [{~} Fire Webs]. The Heatscar Spiders under the town make them, there's a cave right by the entrance arch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.dst: Нужны [{~} Fire Webs]. Их плетут Heatscar Spiders под городом, пещера прямо у арки входа.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.src: Then, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] from the {p} mines. I'd get them myself, but...I'm banned from there since the rubber mallet incident.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.dst: Потом [{~} Magmatic Crystals] из шахт {p}. Сходила бы сама, но… мне туда путь закрыт после случая с резиновым молотком.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.src: Lastly, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. The closest source is in the lava lake just outside {p}. There's a protruding crater in the lake.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.dst: И наконец, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. Ближе всего в лавовом озере сразу за {p}. Там из озера торчит кратер.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.src: Bring back [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], and [{~} Crystallized lava].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.dst: Принеси [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals] и [{~} Crystallized lava].

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.src: The crystal formation... It is definitely here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.src: I will clear the lava... On my signal, move. And do not stop.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.dst: Я расчищу лаву… По сигналу беги. И не останавливайся.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.src: Mhm, looks like everything's in order. Now, for a short explanation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.dst: Угу, вроде всё на месте. Теперь коротко объясню.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#034.src: These materials go into crafting a special charm. It will allow you to resist demon fire.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#034.dst: Из этих материалов делают особый амулет. Он защитит от демонического огня.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#034.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.src: We need to account for if they finish the summoning, so this'll help keep you safe if you end up having to square off with Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.dst: Нужно учесть, что призыв могут завершить, так что это убережёт тебя, если придётся схватиться с Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.src: You will need to craft it yourself, so its magic will bond to you. I've got a station just for it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.dst: Сделать его придётся своими руками, чтобы магия связалась с тобой. У меня есть для этого станок.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.src: Right-click the crafting table in the back and put it together.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.dst: Нажми ПКМ по верстаку сзади и собери его.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.src: Craft the amulet in the crafting table.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.src: We must... visit... Sanba... the enchanter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.dst: Иди к чародейке и зачаруй амулет.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.src: Erm...Korzim, what on earth are you doing here? It's not safe for you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.dst: Э… Korzim, что ты тут делаешь? Здесь для тебя опасно!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.src: Wait, that amulet...oh no, really? Okay, I know what^s going on.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.dst: Постой, этот амулет… о нет, правда? Ладно, я понимаю, что происходит.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.src: We're going to need to give this a little extra kick if you're going to use this for what I think you are.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.dst: Придётся добавить ему силы, если ты собираешься сделать с ним то, что я думаю.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.src: A pinch of fire scarab tail, splash of sulphur, exactly three ounces of old brimstone...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.dst: Щепоть хвоста огненного скарабея, капля серы, ровно три унции древнего горючего камня…!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.src: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.dst: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.src: Meet me in the back, we can't talk out here. You never know who's listening...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.dst: Жду в подсобке, тут говорить нельзя. Мало ли кто слушает…
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.src: Enter the storage room in the enchanter's house.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.dst: Войди в кладовую в доме чародейки.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.src: Supposing you're here to help, Soldier. Garaheth's being summoned if you're getting this...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.dst: Полагаю, ты здесь, чтобы помочь, солдат. Раз это у тебя, значит, призывают Garaheth…
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.src: Axelus prepped a contingency plan for this, but having to put it in action is surreal. Let me fill you in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.dst: Axelus подготовил запасной план на такой случай, но пускать его в ход — это дико. Слушай.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.src: That dragon skeleton lying in the Heights belonged to an Ice Drake. Centuries ago, it was used in the Dogun wars.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.dst: Скелет дракона в Heights принадлежал Ice Drake. Века назад его использовали в войнах с Dogun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.src: It had incredibly potent magic, particularly in its icy breath. The area it hit is still frozen to this day, and shows no signs of thaw.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.dst: Его магия была невероятно сильна, особенно ледяное дыхание. Место удара до сих пор сковано льдом и не думает таять.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.src: According to Axelus' stories, its breath travelled through the tunnels and coalesced someplace deep within...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.dst: По рассказам Axelus, его дыхание прошло по туннелям и собралось где-то в глубине…
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.src: ...becoming True Ice, a potent mixture of sheer cold and magic energy. That's what we will need to combat Garaheth.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.dst: …став True Ice, мощной смесью лютого холода и магии. Это нам и нужно против Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garaheth in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.src: Head north to the Freezing Heights and make your way to the top, now! We've got no time at all!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.dst: Живо на север, в Freezing Heights, и поднимайся на вершину! Времени нет совсем!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.src: Travel to the frozen heights and find {~} True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.dst: Отправляйся в ледяные высоты и найди {~} True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.src: ... This... This used to be...a Dogun town. The Dwarves rendered it barren.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.dst: … Это… Это был… город Dogun. Дворфы сделали его пустошью.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.src: They used the Drake... They chained it up and...forced it to attack. We had to kill it...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.dst: Они использовали Drake… Заковали его и… заставили нападать. Нам пришлось убить его…
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.src: It... froze my town... as it died. I was there... {~} years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.dst: Он… умирая… заморозил мой город. Я был там… {~} лет назад.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.src: I know the way... into the caves.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.src: The True Ice...is deep inside. I will struggle to...stay warm here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.dst: True Ice… глубоко внутри. Мне здесь… трудно не замёрзнуть.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.src: I will try to run through...as quickly as possible. The ice is...painful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.dst: Постараюсь пробежать… как можно быстрее. Лёд… причиняет боль.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.src: We must... move fast... or... we will both.... freeze.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.src: Maybe... I am... hotter than... I thought... do you.. Hear that?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.dst: Может… я… горячее… чем думал… Ты… слышишь?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.src: Oh no... I think... It's... COLLAPSING.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.src: My... feet are... solid... Keep... running.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.src: This is it... The thing that... Killed my families... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.dst: Вот оно… То, что… убило мои семьи… [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.src: Return to the enchanter with the True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.dst: Вернись к чародейке с True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.src: Impressive, you two. Must've been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.src: Here is the staff, {u}. Keep it safe, and don't you go dying on us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.dst: Вот посох, {u}. Береги его и не вздумай умереть.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.src: My husband and I will round up the coalition and get them to act now. We need to get going before-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.dst: Мы с мужем соберём Коалицию и поднимем её сейчас же. Надо успеть, пока—
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.src: ...that's the barracks door. That's the barracks door!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.src: Men! We have to meet for briefing on the surface, the war is due any hour now! Move faster!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.speaker: Maex Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.src: They're already going?! We're out of time! Korzim is waiting for you just upstairs when you reach level {~}. Go train! NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.speaker: Sanba
